scope: explore PC model only; post-hoc diagnosis of existing low/queue/burst, no device validation or policy tuning
energy_idle_single_pairing: three indexed idle/single pairs, crossed with both pair values; not a full factorial or measured range
prespecified_comparisons: P at predicted 1.5 versus B3 per realized coefficient; matched P is an oracle for the interference coefficient only, not future durations or exact pair harm, and diagnoses residual rule loss; over/under are other 3x3 cells. Energy/AP main contrasts hold predicted P=1.5 and compare B3 on the same realized coefficient. No coefficient is a measured interval.
provenance: Frozen CAL-03 development settings, existing evaluation arrivals/vector seeds; all power and AP coefficients are researcher stress values only. Grid fixed before generating diagnostic results.
